overview_description.description:
At Fawaterak, we believe that everyone should have access to tools that can help them run their business effectively. That's why we offer a range of services that can help merchants of all sizes get paid faster, manage their operations, and grow their businesses.

With Fawaterak, merchants can:
Accept credit and debit card payments quickly and securely
Keep track of sales and inventory in real-time
Manage customer relationships and create loyalty programs
Access funding and other financial services to help them grow
Comply with tax and eInvoice regulations

Our Solutions include:
Payment Terminals
Point of Sale Systems
Online Checkout (Payment links, invoices, and product links)
Mobile App Administration
eInvoice and eReceipt Systems
